summary: Iter351 — Anti-fraude Lot 2: admin UI 'no-movement' (auto-reassignation chauffeur immobile) + 3 endpoints. Backend pytest 6/6 PASS (gating 3/3 + GET/PUT round-trip + clamping + reassignments list). Frontend E2E PASS: admin login -> /admin/dispatch -> no-movement-card render, all data-testids présents (toggle, minutes, threshold, save, count), modify 4/120 -> save -> toast succès + valeurs persistées; restore 5/150 OK; non-regression /admin/dispatch full render (Zones, chauffeurs en ligne, comportement, courses en attente, tarification dynamique, heatmap, etc.) sans aucune erreur console fatale. 60 'no_movement_release' historiques affichés correctement avec badges no-movement-driver_* sur le tableau de comportement (visibles dans le DOM).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/dispatch_admin.py PUT /no-movement/config clamps minutes [1..60] and threshold_m [30..2000] server-side — verified with extreme values (0, 9999, 99999) returning 1/60/30/2000 correctly.

GET endpoints (/no-movement/config and /no-movement/reassignments) accept role admin OR dispatcher (permission dispatch.view); only PUT requires admin (permission dispatch.assign) — proper least-privilege gating.
Reassignments endpoint joins moderation_events.type='no_movement_release' with users.name in a single round-trip (no N+1); sorts desc by created_at and caps at 200 — production-safe.
NoMovementCard.jsx polls reassignments every 20s via setInterval cleared on unmount — no memory leak; uses dispatchAdminAPI service (hits process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api/admin/dispatch).
Card hidden until cfg loaded (`if (!cfg) return null;`) — no flicker / no NaN in inputs.
Inputs are type=number with min/max attributes matching backend clamps (1-60 / 30-2000, step=10) — keeps UI ↔ backend constraints consistent.
Toast 'sonner' invoked on both success and error paths with French copy; failure surfaces axios e.response.data.detail when present.
